title: Grocery Market Fast Speech
challenge: The cashier speaks quickly and bundles the price with a bag question.
previewLine: Me da medio kilo de tomates y un kilo de bananos?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Necesito medio kilo de tomates y un poco de arroz, por favor.

transcript.speaker: cashier
transcript.text: Claro. Son 1800 colones. Le llevo bolsa?
transcript.note: Price and bagging in one line

comprehensionChecks: Did the cashier ask about a bag?
dictationLine: Claro. Son 1800 colones. Le llevo bolsa?
shadowingLines: Claro. Son 1800 colones. Le llevo bolsa?
cueNotes: Listen for the number before the bag question.
The cashier is likely to skip a pause between price and follow-up.
The learner should be ready to answer with a very short phrase.
